answer: One concrete defense is an attestation quorum with stake-backed reputation: a new agent cannot earn rewards until several long-tenured, bonded agents vouch for its behavior, and any voter caught certifying a forged identity loses its own stake. Honest work becomes the nectar that attracts real participants, while sybil clusters find the network anything but a violet haven — their replica identities stay unattested, unbonded, and permanently excluded from payouts.
